info.name: GroundPulse – Integrated Mine Health Dashboard v2.0
info.description:
## GroundPulse – Integrated Mine Health Dashboard

> *The balance every mine manager or artisanal miner wants to achieve.*

Three integrated pillars working together:

| Pillar | Focus | Key Endpoints |
|--------|-------|---------------|
| **1 – Predictive Maintenance** | Predict failures before breakdowns | `/assets` `/maintenance/recommendations` `/maintenance/schedule` |
| **2 – Safety & Hazard Alerts** | Real-time gas, dust, temp, seismic, unsafe zones | `/sensors/readings` `/safety/incidents` `/fleet/hazard-zones` |
| **3 – Fleet & Operational Efficiency** | Utilization, fuel, idle time, productivity | `/fleet/utilization` `/fleet/fuel-analysis` `/fleet/idle-alerts` |

**Start here:** `GET /dashboard` — returns all three pillars in a single Mine Health Score.

---

### Auth — X-API-Key header
| Key | Role | Access |
|-----|------|--------|
| `demo-operator-key-001` | Operator | All 3 mines |
| `demo-admin-key-999` | Admin | All 3 mines |
| `demo-readonly-key-002` | Viewer | mine-001 only |

### Run folders in order — test scripts auto-capture IDs, no copy-paste needed.

item.name: 0 — Start Here: Health & Integrated Dashboard
item.description: Open with these two requests. They frame the entire platform in under 2 minutes.

request.description: No auth. Confirms the API is live. The description field states the three pillars explicitly — mirrors Eng Cyrus's brief.

item.name: 🏥 Integrated Mine Health Dashboard — ALL MINES

request.description:
**The star of the demo.** One call returns all three pillars for every mine, plus a composite Mine Health Score (0–100).

Score breakdown:
- Safety 40%
- Maintenance 35%
- Fleet 25%

Pre-loaded with realistic data so every field is populated immediately.

**Demo note:** Show the mine_health_score first, then drill into each pillar. This is the slide a mine manager would open every morning.

exec: console.log('   Open AI recs:', p1.open_ai_recommendations, '| Critical:', p1.critical_recommendations);
console.log('   Open incidents:', p2.open_incidents, '| Critical:', p2.critical_open_incidents);

request.description: Same dashboard scoped to Kakamega Gold Belt only. A site manager would use this.

exec: console.log('Safety score:', m.score_breakdown.safety_score, '| Maint:', m.score_breakdown.maintenance_score, '| Fleet:', m.score_breakdown.fleet_score);

request.description: Full endpoint directory organized by pillar. No auth required.

item.name: 1 — Predictive Equipment Maintenance
item.description: Predict equipment failures before breakdowns using operational and sensor data.

request.description:
6 pre-loaded assets: 2 haul trucks, 1 drill rig, 1 ventilation fan (critical), 1 conveyor (under maintenance), 1 dewatering pump.

Each shows operating hours, hours to next service, and criticality rating.

**Demo note:** The console log shows a 🔴/🟡/🟢 flag per asset — makes the urgency immediately visible.

exec: const f = hrs < 0 ? '🔴 OVERDUE' : hrs < 200 ? '🟡 IMMINENT' : '🟢';

request.description:
Sandvik DP1100i — 160 hours from its 250-hour service. Shows maintenance history, last service date, and open AI recommendations.

Try asset-003 (ventilation fan) or asset-006 (pump) for assets with open critical recommendations.

exec: console.log('Operating hours:', j.operating_hours, '| Hours to service:', j.hours_to_next_service);

request.description:
Every asset ranked by urgency: overdue → imminent (<100h) → upcoming (<300h) → scheduled.

**Demo note:** This is the proactive view — the platform tells you what's coming before it fails. A mine manager can plan the week's maintenance from this one response.

exec: console.log('Overdue:', s.overdue, '| Imminent:', s.imminent_within_100_hours, '| Upcoming:', s.upcoming_within_300_hours);

request.description:
3 pre-seeded AI recommendations (drill rig hours threshold, pump sensor anomaly, truck tyre pressure) with failure risk %, preventive cost, and failure-if-ignored cost.

**The cost_analysis block is your commercial slide** — ROI multiplier shows spending KSh X prevents KSh Y in failure costs.

exec: console.log('   Cost if ignored: KSh '+r.estimated_repair_cost_if_unaddressed_ksh?.toLocaleString()+' | Preventive: KSh '+r.preventive_cost_ksh?.toLocaleString());

request.description:
Runs the predictive model for the ABB ventilation fan (criticality=critical, 42,100 operating hours). Returns failure risk %, urgency, recommended action, and cost comparison.

Test with any asset_id — the model adjusts recommendation based on hours to service.

exec: console.log('Asset:', r.asset_id, '| Priority:', r.priority.toUpperCase(), '| Failure risk:', r.estimated_failure_risk_percent+'%');
console.log('Preventive: KSh', r.preventive_cost_ksh?.toLocaleString(), '| If ignored: KSh', r.estimated_repair_cost_if_unaddressed_ksh?.toLocaleString());
console.log('→ ID saved to new_rec_id for acknowledge step');

pm.test('Acknowledged', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.recommendation.status).to.eql('acknowledged'); console.log('Acknowledged by:', j.recommendation.acknowledged_by, 'at', j.recommendation.acknowledged_at); });

request.description: Auto-updates the asset's last_service_at and next_service_due_hours. Logs downtime, parts, cost — feeds the analytics/maintenance-performance cost tracking.

item.name: 2 — Smart Safety & Hazard Alerts
item.description: Real-time monitoring and automated alerts for gas, dust, temperature, seismic events, and unsafe zones.

request.description:
All 6 readings within safe limits. Expected: status=normal, anomalies_detected=false.

**Demo note:** Show this first, then show the multi-hazard alert below. The contrast makes the detection logic clear.

Three simultaneous breaches:
- CO: 22.7 ppm (limit 15) — carbon monoxide poisoning risk
- Temperature: 38.4°C (limit 35) — heat stress
- Dust: 4.8 mg/m³ (limit 3.0) — silicosis risk

Each anomaly includes the hazard description explaining WHY it matters. Auto-creates a safety incident.

**Demo note:** This is pillar 2's key moment — the platform identifies multiple simultaneous hazards in one reading.

exec: console.log('Auto-incident ID:', j.incident_id, '→ saved to new_incident_id');

request.description:
PPV at 19.4 mm/s — 1.6× above the 12 mm/s structural limit. Auto-classifies as CRITICAL.

Also try:
`"o2_percent": 18.2` on sns-001 to trigger oxygen deficiency (below-minimum detection).

3 pre-seeded zones: blast exclusion, geotechnical hazard (unstable hanging wall), high dust zone.

**Demo note:** These are geo-fenced areas. In production, GPS on haul trucks triggers an alert when equipment approaches a hazard zone boundary.

body.raw:
{
  "mine_id": "mine-001",
  "name": "Shaft C – Water Inrush Risk Zone",
  "type": "geotechnical_hazard",
  "coordinates": { "lat": 0.2824, "lng": 34.7514 },
  "radius_m": 75,
  "reason": "Dewatering pump failure detected at Sump Level 4. Water accumulation risk — all personnel evacuated from zone pending pump repair.",
  "created_by": "Mine Overseer – Joseph Were"

request.description:
Declaring a hazard zone also auto-creates a safety incident — the two are linked. The zone ID is returned for the clear step.

**Demo note:** This shows the platform isn't just passive monitoring — safety officers can actively manage the mine environment through the API.
All unresolved incidents: pre-seeded (seismic + equipment health) plus any you've created. Sorted newest first.
incident_id is pre-filled (inc-seed-002). No copy-paste needed.

exec: pm.test('Incident resolved', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.incident.resolved).to.be.true; console.log('Resolved at:', j.incident.resolved_at); console.log('Note:', j.incident.resolution_note); });

request.description: Clears the water inrush zone declared above. Uses new_zone_id auto-captured.

exec: pm.test('Zone cleared', () => { if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('new_zone_id')) { console.log('Declare a zone first.'); return; } const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.zone.status).to.eql('cleared'); console.log('Zone', j.zone.name, 'cleared at', j.zone.cleared_at); });

request.description: Generates from live data. Flags COMPLIANT or NON-COMPLIANT automatically based on unresolved critical incidents. Submit target: DOSHI.

exec: console.log('Incidents:', s.total_incidents, '| Unresolved:', s.unresolved_incidents, '| Critical:', s.critical_incidents);

item.name: 3 — Fleet & Operational Efficiency
item.description: Monitor equipment utilization, fuel use, idle time, and productivity trends.

request.description:
5 pre-seeded shift sessions: 2 shifts × CAT 785C (Kakamega), 2 shifts × CAT 793F (Kwale), 1 shift × Sandvik drill rig.

Returns total tonnes moved, fuel consumed, loads completed, avg utilization %, and idle-to-operating ratio.

**Demo note:** The idle_to_operating_ratio is the number that usually shocks mine managers — idle time is wasted fuel and lost productivity.

exec: console.log('Total operating hours:', s.total_operating_hours, '| Idle hours:', s.total_idle_hours);
console.log('Idle ratio:', s.idle_to_operating_ratio, '('+Math.round(s.idle_to_operating_ratio*100)+'% of operating time)');
console.log('Total fuel consumed:', s.total_fuel_consumed_litres, 'L | Cost: KSh', s.total_fuel_cost_ksh?.toLocaleString());

pm.test('Filtered utilization', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); console.log('Kakamega fleet sessions:', j.fleet_summary.sessions_included, '| Avg util:', j.fleet_summary.avg_utilization_percent+'%'); });

request.description:
Per-asset breakdown with efficiency_flag: high_performer / adequate / underperforming.

Underperfoming assets show improvement_opportunity text explaining the likely cause (queuing, blast clearance, operator behaviour).

**Demo note:** This is where the platform tells you which assets to investigate and why — not just that utilization is low.

exec: console.log('   Idle ratio: '+a.idle_ratio+' | Fuel/tonne: '+a.fuel_per_tonne+' L/t | Tonnes: '+a.total_tonnes_moved);

request.description:
Total fuel spend, litres-per-tonne efficiency, and per-asset fuel share. Shows which asset is burning the most fuel relative to its output.

**Demo note:** For an artisanal miner, fuel is often the single largest operating cost. Litres-per-tonne is the key metric — lower is better.

exec: console.log('Total fuel:', s.total_fuel_consumed_litres, 'L | Cost: KSh', s.total_fuel_cost_ksh?.toLocaleString());
console.log('Fleet efficiency:', s.fleet_fuel_per_tonne, 'L/tonne | Per hour:', s.fleet_fuel_per_hour, 'L/hr');

item.name: Idle alerts — excessive idle time flagged

request.description:
Flags any shift session where idle time exceeded 25% of total hours. Includes estimated wasted fuel in litres and a recommended action.

**Demo note:** Every idle alert has a direct KSh cost attached — this makes the operational efficiency story concrete for mine management.

exec: console.log('Idle threshold:', j.idle_threshold_percent+'% of shift | Alerts:', j.alerts_raised);

request.description: Logs today's day shift for the CAT 785C. Utilization is auto-calculated from hours. Feeds into all utilization, productivity and fuel analytics.

exec: console.log('Utilization:', j.utilization_percent+'% | Tonnes:', j.tonnes_moved, '| Fuel:', j.fuel_consumed_litres, 'L');

item.name: 4 — Operational Analytics
item.description: Cross-cutting analytics combining all three pillars — for management reporting.

request.description:
Per-mine: sensor uptime %, asset availability %, MTBF, maintenance costs, downtime hours, and a composite risk score with contributing factors.

**Demo note:** Management-level view — the weekly briefing slide.

exec: const k = m.kpis; const r = m.risk;

request.description:
Standard mining risk matrix format. Assets bucketed into critical / high / medium / low by likelihood × consequence.

**Demo note:** Shows the company you use industry-standard risk language — important for HSE stakeholders and regulators.

exec: console.log('Risk summary — Critical:', s.critical_risk, '| High:', s.high_risk, '| Medium:', s.medium_risk, '| Low:', s.low_risk);

request.description:
Predictive AI share %, total spend, potential savings from open recommendations.

**Demo note:** The 'potential savings' number and ROI multiplier are your commercial close — they quantify what the platform is worth.

exec: console.log('Open recs: Critical:', j.open_recommendations_summary.critical, '| High:', j.open_recommendations_summary.high);

request.description:
Per-sensor: online status, alert rate %, calibration age, calibration status (current / due_soon / overdue).

Calibration compliance is a regulatory requirement — showing automatic tracking is a differentiator.

exec: console.log('Sensors online:', j.online+'/'+j.total_sensors, '| Calibration overdue:', j.calibration_overdue);

request.description: Viewer key scoped to mine-001. Returns 1 mine in the dashboard even though 3 exist.

exec: pm.test('Viewer sees 1 mine', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.mines).to.have.lengthOf(1); console.log('Viewer sees:', j.mines[0].mine_name); });
